messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: high rate of cuda allocation failures in pool-uc-1 (rule: cuda.alloc.fail.rate > 5/min)

pagerduty: Incident #PD-8241 triggered (urgent) — assigned to on-call

emma: Acked on PagerDuty. I'm on it. Pulling logs now.

raj: ping — seeing similar alerts in eu-west-1 and na-west-2?

emma: eu-west-1 primarily, slight spike in na-west-2. Errors started ~02:17 UTC.

maria: quick summary from metrics: pool-uc-1 GPU alloc fail rate 12% for last 5m, autoscaler didn't spike because mem pressure threshold wasn't hit. KV cache prefetch rate spiked right before.

leo: can you paste the runtime logs? I want to see the allocator error.

emma: logs (from runtime pod uc-runtime-7c6f):

```
E 02:18:43.112 runtime_gpu.cpp:421 allocate(): CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: 0x700 (client=solver)
W 02:18:43.113 kvcache.cpp:254 prefetch_task(): prefetch queue length=2048 rate=180/s
E 02:18:43.114 kvcache.cpp:267 allocate_kv_buffer(): failed to reserve GPU mem 8.0GiB requested
E 02:18:43.115 rpc_server.cpp:178 handle_infer(): returning error to client: cuda_alloc_failed
```

emma: seen the prefetch queue length — looks like noisy prefetch spike.

raj: that tracks with a batch/prefetch regression we rolled yesterday (runtime v2.7.3). Could be aggressive prefetch concurrency.

maria: quick risk assessment: affected requests are mostly long-context LLM chat generation from Dedicated customers using model-x-32k. Short inference and embeddings unaffected. Estimated customer impact: 8–15% of requests hitting 5xx for those customers in eu-west-1.

leo: mitigation plan options: 1) disable kv prefetch globally (quick, blunt), 2) throttle prefetch concurrency on pool-uc-1 (safer), 3) fallback route to smaller model-variant. I'd do throttle + route.

emma: I'm going to throttle prefetch concurrency on the pool and add a temporary routing policy to steer traffic to model-variant-xq (quantized) for the affected dedicated pool. Applying throttle now.

emma: command run:
```
# reduce prefetch concurrency for pool-uc-1
redwoodctl runtime patch pool pool-uc-1 --set kvcache.prefetch_concurrency=2
```

incident-bot: action accepted: runtime config update applied to pool-uc-1 (changeid: cfg-9921)

pagerduty: Escalation timer set to 12 minutes.

maria: routing change ready. I'll add a soft-fallback rule (no-drop) to send 40% traffic to model-variant-xq.

maria: command:
```
redwoodctl route add --pool pool-uc-1 --from model-x-32k --to model-xq-32k --weight 40 --reason "mitigation: reduce mem pressure"
```

incident-bot: route change queued, applying... done.

emma: Monitoring the error rate...

~120s later~

emma: alloc failures dropped from 12% -> 2.3% in eu-west-1. Latency slightly increased on the routed requests but errors are down.

raj: nice. Any customer-facing impact to call out?

maria: We've had transient 5xx for some Dedicated tenants (billing-tier customers). I'll open a private incident email thread to CS with current ETA for full rollforward (30m).

leo: longer-term root cause: regression in prefetch concurrency heuristics in v2.7.3 that mis-estimated KV cache footprint for model-x-32k. Plan: revert heuristics patch or add per-model caps. I'll open PR.

emma: Next steps for now: keep throttle, keep 40% fallback, observe for 30m. If stable, roll a targeted rollback of the prefetch heuristics to canary then prod.

oncall-rotation: heading in in 10m for handoff. If you need me earlier ping @oncall-rotation.

pagerduty: Reminder: if incident persists beyond escalation timer, follow PD runbook for multi-pool evacuations.

emma: quick note on commands used during mitigation:
```
# check pod failures
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l pool=pool-uc-1 -o wide
# taint/evict one noisy runtime pod if needed
kubectl -n runtime cordon uc-runtime-7c6f && kubectl -n runtime drain uc-runtime-7c6f --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

raj: Emma — can you hand this to me at 02:50 UTC? I'll be on for the next shift.

emma: yep. Handoff: current status:
- Incident: PD-8241 (cuda alloc failures)
- Mitigation: kvcache.prefetch_concurrency reduced to 2 on pool-uc-1; 40% traffic routed to model-variant-xq-32k
- Impact: error rate for affected Dedicated customers dropped from ~12% to ~2.3%; some increased latency for routed requests (~150ms median extra)
- Next actions: monitor for 30m; prepare rollback PR for prefetch heuristics (leo); CS notified privately with ETA 30m (maria)
- Links: runtime logs: https://logs.internal.redwood/runtime/pool-uc-1?q=cuda_alloc_failed; PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8241

emma: handing off to @raj now. I'm available if you need context. :thumbsup:

raj: taking over. Thanks Emma. I'll keep track and escalate if we see reversion.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8241 acknowledged by emma, then reassigned to raj (handoff recorded).

maria: I'll keep the CS thread updated. Leaving monitoring alarms on for kvcache queue length and cuda alloc rate.

leo: opened PR #4512 to add per-model kvcache caps and a conservative prefetch default. Marking as urgent.

raj: moving this to monitoring; will reopen thread if anything changes. Good job team.
